decks.notes: This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on creating a fast and aggressive playstyle. It utilizes low-cost creatures like Generous Ent and Cauldron Familiar to put pressure on the opponent early on. The deck also includes efficient removal spells such as Cast Down and Snuff Out to eliminate any threats from the opponent's side. Additionally, it utilizes cards like Makeshift Munitions and Deadly Dispute to gain advantage through sacrificing its own creatures. The mixture of creatures, removal, and sacrifice effects creates a synergistic and aggressive strategy capable of overwhelming the opponent.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing removal spells, creature threats, and graveyard interaction. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building its own board presence, using cards like Crypt Rats and Avenging Hunter for board control, and Lembas for card advantage. The deck also includes graveyard hate with Bojuka Bog and creature removal like Cast Down and Deadly Dispute. Its mana base includes Golgari and artifact lands for additional synergy with the deck's overall strategy.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying a board full of artifact creatures and utilizing cheap artifacts to power them up and generate card advantage. By efficiently casting spells, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of aggressive creatures, backed up by powerful artifacts like All That Glitters. The mana base includes artifact lands which can be tapped for multiple colors of mana, allowing for a smooth curve and explosive starts. The key strategy is to maintain a high tempo and pressure the opponent before they can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board through removal spells and sweepers, while generating value with token creatures and sacrificing them for benefits. It utilizes cards like Crypt Rats and Chainer's Edict to keep the opponent's board in check, while using cards like Deadly Dispute and Avenging Hunter to generate tokens and gain card advantage. The deck also includes some recursion with cards like Blood Fountain and Witch's Cottage to bring back key threats. Ultimately, the goal is to outvalue the opponent and grind them out through attrition.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a combination of efficient creature removal, counterspells, and card draw. By playing defensively and disrupting the opponent's game plan, the player aims to dominate the board and out-value their opponent. The inclusion of powerful cards like Gurmag Angler and Snuff Out allows for strong board presence and removal options. The deck aims to outlast opponents through card advantage and strategic plays, ultimately grinding out a win through attrition.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. By utilizing low-cost creatures with haste like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Bushwhacker, along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero. Additionally, cards like Voldaren Epicure and Implement of Combustion help maintain pressure on the opponent while generating additional value. The inclusion of cards like Lava Dart and Fireblast provide added reach to finish off opponents. The deck's strategy is to go all out and win the game as quickly as possible.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with low-cost, efficient creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing counterspells and bounce effects, the deck aims to control the board while pressuring the opponent with a mix of evasive creatures and card draw. The key strategy is to establish an early board presence and maintain control of the game tempo, ultimately outpacing the opponent and securing a quick victory through aggression and disruption.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Goblin tribe in combination with cards that allow for sacrificing and reanimating creatures to create a powerful combo. By utilizing cards like Skirk Prospector, Putrid Goblin, and Troll of Khazad-dûm alongside Exhume and Unearth, the deck aims to quickly rebuild a board presence and overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Dark Ritual and Deadly Dispute help to accelerate the deck's strategy, while cards like Matron and Wellspring provide additional utility. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and outpace the opponent with its aggressive plays.

The deck focuses on quickly building up a powerful creature by attaching multiple aura enchantments to it, making it difficult for opponents to deal with. With a strong mix of hexproof creatures and efficient auras, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a large, evasive threat in the early game. By utilizing mana ramp and card draw, the deck can consistently deploy threats and keep the pressure on opponents. Overall, the strategy revolves around creating a strong, unstoppable creature through the synergy between auras and hexproof creatures.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with cheap, artifact creatures and pump them up with cards like All That Glitters. By using cards like Springleaf Drum and Chromatic Star to generate mana, the deck can quickly cast multiple threats in a single turn. This deck also utilizes affinity mechanics to reduce the cost of artifacts, allowing for explosive starts. Additionally, cards like Metallic Rebuke and Relic of Progenitus provide disruption and graveyard hate against opposing strategies. The key strategy is to swarm the board with efficient threats and close out the game quickly.

The key concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to constantly put pressure on the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures like Glint Hawk and Kor Skyfisher, backed up with removal and burn spells such as Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast. The deck focuses on generating card advantage through cards like Thraben Inspector and Ichor Wellspring, while also utilizing artifacts like Experimental Synthesizer and Lembas for additional value. The inclusion of Foundry Helix and Makeshift Munitions provides additional reach and finishing power, making this deck a fast and aggressive contender in the Pauper format.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and aggressive strategy. By utilizing efficient creatures like Thraben Inspector, Glint Hawk, and Kor Skyfisher, along with powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Additionally, the deck includes support cards like Spare Supplies and Guardian of the Guildpact to provide additional value and resilience. The inclusion of cards like Journey to Nowhere and Prismatic Strands helps to control the board, while the land base allows for consistent mana production and flexibility.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through card advantage and tempo plays using Ephemerate. By utilizing creatures that provide value when they enter the battlefield and repeatable effects like Archaeomancer's ability to return instants or sorceries from the graveyard, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent. Sunscape Familiar and God-Pharaoh's Faithful help in gaining life and surviving long enough to establish a dominant board presence. With a mix of counterspells, card draw, and flicker effects, the deck is designed to disrupt the opponent's game plan and secure victory.

The main idea behind this Pauper 1 vs 1 deck is to control the game using a combination of removal spells and sacrifice effects, while also generating card advantage through cards like Ichor Wellspring and Lembas. The deck aims to outvalue opponents by recurring creatures from the graveyard with cards like Chainer's Edict and Innocent Blood, and by overwhelming them with creatures like Avenging Hunter and Crypt Rats. The inclusion of Khalni Garden and Thorn of the Black Rose helps to ensure a steady stream of creature tokens and card draw.

This deck focuses on aggressively putting creatures onto the battlefield while also utilizing artifacts and sacrificing them for value. It aims to swarm the board with efficient threats like Myr Enforcer and Gurmag Angler, while also employing cards like Krark-Clan Shaman and Galvanic Blast to control the opponent's board. The deck is designed to be quick and versatile, with the ability to draw cards and deal damage efficiently. It also includes a mana base that supports its artifact-centered strategy.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to maintain board control and delay opponents' strategies. It also includes some creatures with value abilities to generate card advantage and pressure the opponent. The mana base includes snow lands to enable synergy with Skred and Ephemerate, allowing for efficient removal and tempo plays. The deck aims to outvalue opponents by efficiently dealing with threats and steadily developing its own game plan until it can secure a win condition.
